verdict.rationale: Apify Actors take a `startUrls` list as input (apify-docs-15), and runs can be driven asynchronously through the Python client's asyncio support (apify-docs-19). Webhooks fire follow-up actions when a run finishes or fails (apify-docs-14, apify-docs-29), and client retries plus proxy rotation support reliability at scale (apify-docs-27, apify-docs-8, apify-docs-31). Missing for 10: explicit evidence or benchmarks of runs handling thousands of URLs, documentation of a fire-and-forget start call or a dedicated batch endpoint (only call-and-wait is shown in apify-docs-23), and independent hands-on corroboration of large-batch scraping.
